title: DisCoMBO: Steering Expert-in-the-Loop Black Box Optimization via Distributional Conformance
abstract: arXiv:2609.36472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO) traditionally relies on Bayesian or ensembling surrogates for uncertainty quantification. While historically treated as fully data-driven, SMBO increasingly integrates external domain expertise to accelerate discovery. To overcome the opaque guidance and diminished integration fidelity of standard acquisition re-weighting, Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) have emerged as a generative surrogate alternative, enabling direct knowledge injection via conditional sampling. However, these generative routines lack the formal exploration-exploitation semantics required for rigorous optimization. We introduce the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel metric that unifies the flexibility and efficiency of PCs with a formal uncertainty framework. DisCo provides a bounded, $[0, 1]$-normalized measure of model "surprise" that (1) recovers properties comparable to kernel-based uncertainty known from, e.

translated_title: DisCoMBO：通过分布一致性引导专家在环黑盒优化
translated_abstract: 序贯模型优化（SMBO）传统上依赖贝叶斯或集成代理模型进行不确定性量化。尽管历来被视为完全数据驱动的方法，SMBO 正日益整合外部领域专家知识以加速科学发现。为了克服标准采集函数重加权中引导不透明、整合保真度降低的问题，概率电路作为一种生成式代理模型替代方案应运而生，能够通过条件采样直接注入专家知识。然而，这些生成式方法缺乏严格优化所需的正式探索-利用语义。我们提出了分布一致性得分，这是一种新颖的度量标准，将概率电路的灵活性与效率同正式的不确定性框架统一起来。DisCo 提供了一个有界的、归一化到 [0, 1] 区间的模型“惊讶度”度量，该度量（1）恢复了与已知基于核函数的不确定性度量相当的特性……
tldr: 论文提出分布一致性得分（DisCo）这一新指标，将概率电路的生成式灵活性与正式的不确定性量化框架相结合，从而在 DisCoMBO 框架中实现专家知识透明注入且具备严格探索-利用语义的黑盒优化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Distributional Conformance Score (DisCo), a novel bounded [0,1]-normalized uncertainty metric that unifies the flexibility of probabilistic circuits with formal uncertainty quantification, enabling rigorous expert-in-the-loop black box optimization (DisCoMBO).
